description: Main entry point for the 'swabble' command-line interface, handling command dispatch and subcommand execution for a macOS application.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Asynchronous function that initializes CLI descriptors, resolves the command invocation, dispatches it, and returns an exit code.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handles dispatching based on the first command in the input, routing to specific handlers.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Handles 'swabble' subcommands, dispatching to specific functions based on the subcommand.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping 'swabble' subcommands to their handler functions.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a specific subcommand from the path array, throws error if missing.
